up: Find all molecules that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL3638391'. For each distinct molecule, return its ChEMBL identifier (molecule_chembl_id) and preferred name (pref_name). Use the compound_records table to link documents to molecules, joining on doc_id. Do not apply any additional filters or limits.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, md.pref_name FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3638391';
